The ab-block red was watched in attempt 1 (1/5 on unchanged code) and under the mutation probe below. DESIGN (unchanged from attempt 1). _worktrees.py: advance_plan (pure: work = changed paths outside the caller's records, overlap = work that moved, a non-empty overlap is the refusal naming every overlapping path); advance_tree (refuses before any write unless the tree's HEAD IS the base, git describes the span and the tree, and no work path moved; copies every changed path in memory and on disk under the tree's own admin dir (audit-advance/), puts record paths back at the base one path at a time, runs `git checkout -q --detach <head>` WITHOUT -f, then compares every work path byte for byte; any failure undoes from the copy - checkout -f --detach <base>, bytes written back, re-verified - restored True and the copy removed, or restored False with the copy kept and named); advance_task_tree (reads the base from THIS task's marker, moves, rewrites the marker: base = new head, baseMoves += {from, to, moved, at}; a move whose marker could not be written is advanced WITH error); write_record (the marker writer, moved down from manage-worktrees). No rebase, no commit, no rewritten SHA: drive-phase.py's rule 'never rebase - it rewrites the task commit SHAs' stays true. drive-phase.py: gate_step calls advance_member before refresh_member_records for a member tree, so the first gate of a returned task, a rerun and a retry all follow the head; on a move it updates wave.bases, writes a `task.tree.advanced` journal row (parent old base, commit new base, changes = files that moved) and a did-line; a refused move gates the tree where it is and names the overlap; an unrestorable move or an unwritten marker stops the drive. integrate-task.py reads the base from the marker, so the work is diffed against the new base (ab3, tv2). manage-worktrees.py: _write_record delegates to _worktrees.write_record with identical output; no verb (a verb would need PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md changes, lints e1 and g1). Tests: tests/test__worktrees.py av1-av12 on a real repository; tests/test_drive_phase.py ab-block (ab1, ab2, ab3, ab1m red twin, ab4) plus wq2 narrowed to files the phase did not move and the wq1m twin also disabling advance_member; tests/test_manage_worktrees.py tv1-tv4.
